review_candidates.title: Solutions Architect
review_candidates.description: DIVE INTO MOMENT FACTORY’S UNIVERSE We come from many different places, but what unites us is our passion. At Moment Factory, each new project is a blank page awaiting the creativity and talent of our whole team, no matter the individual responsibilities, roles, or fields. Our desire to innovate, to take risks, and to learn from our mistakes and from each other is what allows us to create collective projects that go above and beyond. Today, thanks to a team of 450 creative minds, we have been able to create immersive multimedia environments for artists, museums, airports, brands, theme parks and events, as well as our signature shows. No matter the canvas be it film, lighting, multimedia architecture, sound design, special effects, or interactive projects the thirst for experimentation and innovation is at the core of our DNA. YOUR MISSION As a Solutions Architect, you will act as a technological pillar for Moment Factory’s integrated systems. Bringing together software and infrastructure expertise, you will be responsible for the overall design, stability, and long-term sustainability of our technology solutions. You will be responsible for transforming creative ideas into systems that are replicable, secure, and ready to be outsourced. You will ensure consistency between our internal “product” solutions and client projects, while establishing a technical framework that enables production to be successfully outsourced. At the heart of the action, you will bring the same openness and rigor to internal development initiatives—innovation, products, tooling, and pipelines—as you do to client projects. You will connect every internal technological advancement with on-the-ground realities, client requirements, and the excellence of our deliverables in operations (Operation support - SAO). YOUR TEAM Within Moment Factory’s Centre of Expertise, you will join the Technology Architects and Systems Developers team, a multidisciplinary group made up of Software Architects, Solutions Architects, and Systems Developers. By breaking down the traditional boundary between software and systems infrastructure, our team designs end-to-end technology ecosystems at the intersection of the digital, interactive, and physical worlds. We bridge the gap between creative vision and the real-world implementation of systems, from ideation and proof of concept through to final on-site delivery. You will work closely with Technical Directors, AV Designers, and many other experts across the studio. Within our team, we value listening, mutual support, knowledge sharing, and continuous development. We encourage everyone to leverage their experience, share their ideas, and contribute to internal initiatives. EXPLORE YOUR FUTURE ROLE Creative Design Direction Get involved from the ideation phase to help shape creative directions from day one of each project. Propose emerging technologies and cutting-edge technical innovations to push the boundaries of visual and interactive storytelling. Assess the technical feasibility of artistic concepts and propose viable alternatives that preserve the creative intent without compromising system stability. Make complex technical trade-offs between artistic ambition and the realities and constraints of technical delivery. Replicability Select and standardize internal technology tools and software building blocks to actively prevent and minimize technical debt. Design and document modular, standardized architecture models across the company’s projects. Automate the deployment of on-site infrastructure by promoting modern Infrastructure-as-Code and containerization approaches. Ensure system consistency and compliance to enable identical, simultaneous deployments across multiple sites worldwide. Product Integration Ensure the optimal integration of internally developed software and technology solutions across client projects. Ensure technical consistency and connectivity between Moment Factory products and the overall project infrastructure. Bring field realities, constraints, and technical needs directly to the product team to help shape future versions. Production Strategy (Opperation support - SAO) Define working methodologies, production workflows (pipelines), and automation tools to maximize the efficiency of technical delivery teams. Work closely with Project Managers (Content and Interactive) to co-develop the technical production strategy, assess project scope, and validate delivery budgets. Play a mandatory decision-making role at key validation stages (e.g., Map Meetings). Technology Partnerships & Outsourcing Identify, assess, and validate strategic external partners and suppliers (hardware, software, AI solutions) capable of integrating into Moment Factory’s ecosystem. Define and document the technical framework, code/system quality standards, and interfaces (SDKs, APIs, protocols) to be provided to service partners. Act as the final authority responsible for testing, auditing, and validating the technical compliance and integrity of all third-party deliverables before final integration. Cybersecurity & Reliability Define and ensure compliance with Security by Design protocols for data and infrastructure, both for permanent installations (airports, theme parks) and temporary events. Ensure the high availability, resilience, and long-term sustainability of solutions deployed worldwide. YOUR BACKGROUND INCLUDES Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Programming, or equivalent experience. 8 to 12 years of professional experience in technology, including at least 3 years specifically in solutions architecture for complex application environments. Proven experience managing technical projects and writing architecture documentation. Strong knowledge of the Microsoft platform, with expertise in APIs (REST/JSON-RPC), Python, and SaaS/Cloud solutions. Proven expertise in data flows. Advanced networking knowledge (Cisco, Ubiquiti), virtualization (Docker, Kubernetes, Proxmox), and Windows/Linux environments. Strong knowledge of Node-RED and DMX, RS232, Dante, and NDI protocols. Experience with Disguise, TouchDesigner, Unreal Engine, and Unity3D. In-depth knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies. Knowledge of and/or interest in artificial intelligence. Your Transversal Skills Ability to assess Build vs. Buy models and negotiate with technology partners. Ability to navigate creative, technical, and financial priorities. Ability to maintain a positive atmosphere, prioritize human qualities, and manage stress in a production environment. Excellent ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders. Bilingualism (French/English) is essential. A FEW PERKS OF WORKING AT MOMENT FACTORY Hybrid work model to help optimize work-life balance. 2 sick days for a 3-month internship. Daily meals at reduced prices, plus snacks and coffee available at all times. A dedicated Studio Life team that acts as a catalyst for employee well-being initiatives, including physical and mental health, social activities, and more. Corporate discounts with several Quebec-based companies; Access to Moment Factory sports teams (soccer, softball, ultimate frisbee, etc.). If this role sounds like a good fit for you, we invite you to submit your application today. Unfortunately, we are unable to follow up with every candidate, so only those selected for the next steps will be contacted.Thank you for considering a career at Moment Factory. We look forward to getting to know you! Your resume will be read by Billy.

review_candidates.description: Company DescriptionCreated by Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) in 1986, Epicentre carries out field epidemiology, training and medical research in support of MSF's humanitarian objectives. We have 3 research centres in France, Niger and Uganda and epidemiologists on site. Our areas of expertise cover infectious diseases (malaria, TB, HIV, cholera, Ebola, etc.), neglected diseases (leishmaniasis, trypanosomiasis, etc.) and chronic diseases that are on the rise in African countries, such as diabetes and cancer. Job DescriptionContext The Uganda Research Centre conducts research on public health issues relevant to Africa, according to GCP (Good Clinical Practice) quality standards, in close collaboration with MSF, the Mbarara University of Science and Technology, and other health sector actors. Current projects, including clinical and vaccine trials, focus on tuberculosis, HIV, central nervous system infections and yellow fever. Mission and Responsibilities Reporting to the Data Management, IT and Compliance Coordinator, the Data Manager–Programmer (DM Programmer) will work closely with the Data Management and Data Science teams, as well as study teams across Epicentre. The DM Programmer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining clinical data management systems and tools that support research studies. The role will ensure the effective implementation of data collection processes and the delivery of high-quality, reliable data in compliance with ICH Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines and applicable regulatory requirements. This responsibility covers studies conducted at Epicentre’s research centres in Uganda and Niger, as well as decentralized and multi-country projects for which Epicentre oversees data management activities. Visit scheduling. Reconciliation processes. Build reusable software modules and institutional tools. Maintain source code repositories and development documentation. Build dashboards for data quality monitoring. Develop tools for detecting missing, inconsistent, duplicate, or outlier data. Support implementation of risk-based and centralized monitoring approaches. Clinical Database Development Design and build electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs). Infrastructure and Technical Support Support deployment and maintenance of study databases. Assist with server configuration, backup procedures, disaster recovery, and system performance monitoring. Troubleshoot technical issues affecting data management systems. Collaborate with IT personnel on secure hosting and system maintenance. Compliance and Validation Develop and maintain system validation documentation. Ensure all developments comply with:- ICH-GCP (Good Clinical Practice). GCDMP (Good Clinical Data Management Practices). GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation). Epicentre SOPs. Maintain change control and versioning processes. Innovation and Digital Transformation Evaluate new technologies and platforms. Develop AI-ready and analytics-ready data pipelines. Support interoperability initiatives. Contribute to institutional tool development and DSI roadmap priorities. QualificationsEducation Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Biostatistics, Health Informatics, or a related field. Additional training or specialization in Clinical Data Management, Biomedical Informatics, Clinical Research, or Digital Health would be an asset. Professional Experience Minimum 4 years of professional experience in software development, clinical data management, research informatics, or related fields. Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining data management systems supporting clinical, epidemiological, or public health research. Experience supporting clinical trials and/or epidemiological research projects. Experience developing and maintaining production-grade data systems in resource-limited settings is highly desirable. Previous experience with MSF or other humanitarian organizations would be an asset. Knowledge and Competencies Required Advanced REDCap configuration and REDCap API management. Strong proficiency in R and experience developing applications using Shiny. Version control using Git. Data validation, testing, and quality control methodologies. Good understanding of clinical research data structures and data management workflows. Good understanding of ICH-GCP (Good Clinical Practice) requirements. Experience with computerized system validation, documentation, change control, and version management processes. Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable federal, state, provincial, and country-specific leave disability, accommodation and employment requirements. Escalate complex leave, disability, accommodation, or compliance matters to senior team members as appropriate. Support audits, reporting, and leave-related metrics by maintaining data accuracy and documentation standards. Strong ability to manage employee cases from intake through return to work, balancing employee experience, operational requirements, and regulatory obligations. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to effectively partner with employees, managers, HR, Payroll, Benefits, vendors, and other key stakeholders. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including the ability to assess complex situations, identify risks, and recommend practical solutions. High attention to detail and commitment to data integrity when maintaining leave records, reporting, and case documentation. Experience utilizing HR technology platforms, preferably Workday, case management systems, reporting tools, and Microsoft Office. Ability to identify process improvement opportunities and leverage technology and AI-enabled tools to enhance operational efficiency, employee communications, and service delivery. Demonstrated sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism when handling sensitive and confidential employee information. Global mindset with the ability to navigate varying leave, disability, and accommodation practices across multiple countries and jurisdictions. Experience with Workday, ServiceNow, or similar HRIS and case management platforms. Familiarity with disability management, workplace accommodations, and interactive process administration. Experience developing reports, dashboards, and leave-related metrics. Experience leveraging AI tools, including Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or other generative AI solutions to improve operational efficiency, reporting, process documentation, and employee communications. CEBS, SHRM-CP, PHR, CHRP, or other relevant professional certification.
